findings.title: IHH said to join race for TPG’s Malaysian hospitals - The Edge Singapore
findings.reason: The report indicates that hospital operator IHH is joining the race to acquire TPG's Malaysian hospitals, substantiating the claim of private hospital expansion and active growth moves in Malaysia's private healthcare market.

articles.title: Malaysia Sector Outlook: Construction - Year of Execution
articles.claim_summary: 2026 is the Malaysian construction sector's "Execution Year": record 2025 contract awards (RM202.5 billion) are expected to translate into peak earnings delivery for major contractors. Budget 2026 development expenditure eases to RM81 billion (from RM86 billion in 2025), but the 13th Malaysia Plan maintains a RM430 billion total allocation through 2030, sustaining infrastructure commitment. Data centres remain the key structural growth driver alongside transport, industrial parks and renewable energy projects; margin risks from steel/cement/labour inflation are seen as manageable given strong order books.

findings.title: Twenty-seven data centre projects worth RM226b greenlit by task force — Digital Ministry - The Edge Malaysia
findings.reason: The report indicates that 27 data centre projects valued at RM226 billion have been greenlit by the Digital Ministry's task force, corroborating the claim that data centres represent a primary structural growth driver for Malaysia's construction and infrastructure sector.
